left.text: The shader library is one quality-sorted catalog shared by the Design Lab and the animation tool. Brand colors seed every material; a new composition opens on gem smoke, the material behind the blog covers and the reel. The six tiles are live renders from the library.

items.value: 112 presets in 29 families, gem smoke, liquid metal, god rays and smoke ring among them.
Nine Shaders.com studies, six original design studies and four house renderers.
One each from ShaderGradient, the WebGL fluid simulation and the holo cloth material.
Fluid 28, light 22, metal 16, gradient 33 and graphic 35; 15 palettes and 9 look presets.
